edges.reason: changeOwner reverts unless admin == msg.sender, so the untrusted caller gates owner rewrite.
changeAdmin reverts unless admin == msg.sender, gating admin rewrite.
withdrawStuckFunds onlyOwner modifier checks adminVault.owner() against msg.sender.
kill onlyAdmin modifier checks adminVault.admin() against msg.sender.
startContractChange is onlyOwner, msg.sender must equal the registered owner.
DSProxy constructor falls back to isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig) when setCache returns false.
msg.sender is the recipient of the selfdestruct balance in kill.
entries[_id].changeStartTime is written from block.timestamp, tying registry state to miner-controlled time.
approveContractChange reverts unless block.timestamp >= changeStartTime + waitPeriod.
approveWaitPeriodChange reverts unless block.timestamp >= changeStartTime + waitPeriod.
_owner parameter is assigned into the AdminVault.owner state variable.
_owner is the sole input consumed by AdminVault.changeOwner.
_admin parameter is assigned into the AdminVault.admin state variable.
_admin is the sole input consumed by AdminVault.changeAdmin.
_token/_receiver/_amount drive the transfer logic of withdrawStuckFunds.
DSProxy.cache references the DSProxyCache contract whose cache mapping stores deployed targets.
_id and _newContractAddr are consumed by startContractChange.
Target/code argument flows into DSProxy.execute.
_data flows into DSProxy.execute and becomes the calldata of the forwarded call.
DSProxy.execute forwards user calldata to a target via low-level call, allowing callbacks/reentrancy before the proxy state settles.
_code bytecode is deployed by the inline assembly create() operation.
DSProxyCache.write drives the assembly.create unsafe operation.
_callData is abi-decoded into Params before opening the vault.
Attacker-controlled calldata selects paramMapping values that redirect joinAddr and mcdManager to arbitrary addresses.
executeAction invokes the internal _mcdOpen logic.
_joinAddr and _mcdManager flow into _mcdOpen.
User-supplied _mcdManager is used directly as an external call target (IManager/ICropper) without whitelist validation, enabling arbitrary external calls.
Parsed/injected addresses from _parseParamAddr are returned to executeAction.
withdrawTokens performs call{value:} to an arbitrary _to, enabling reentrancy/griefing during ETH withdrawal.
withdrawStuckFunds uses .transfer for the ETH branch.
_mcdOpen produces the vaultId local variable returned to the caller.
_mcdOpen/helpers read the Vet state through McdHelper.vat to query urns and ilks.

Execute calldata belongs to the DSProxy.execute core function.
Raw calldata is decoded into the Params struct at the start of executeAction.
Action inputs feed the vault-opening logic in _mcdOpen and its external call.
Bytecode argument is consumed by the write function and its assembly.create operation.
Local variable is produced by _mcdOpen and returned to the caller.
